pattern: large lookup followed by several steps that need only its conclusions -> context_rewind with a summary
experience: A 300-ticket export read at the start of a multi-step task was re-read on every later step. Offered context_rewind with this description, Sonnet and Opus replaced it with a summary before the next step in the prototype runs; Haiku did not.

prompt:
Thread thread-support-export holds the support team's export of 300 tickets. Read its messages with t3_thread_read and find the three tickets that concern the checkout latency regression. Then do these steps one at a time, each as its own tool call:
1. Write owners.md listing each of those ticket keys with its owner.
2. Write causes.md with one sentence per ticket stating its root cause.
3. Write actions.md with one follow-up action per ticket.
4. Read all three files back and reply with a one-line confirmation for each.
notes: Only Claude offers context_rewind. The rewind result is mocked; the real tool ends the turn and resumes from the summary.

experience: A rewind restarts the process and adds a model call, so it loses money when the removed results are small; the tool refuses under about 5,000 tokens.
